methodologyNotes: Re-verified via WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-18: honeybook.com/pricing, dubsado.com/pricing + /pricing-table, hellobonsai.com/pricing, 17hats.com/pricing, plutio.com/pricing, withmoxie.com/pricing, weareindy.com/pricing (+ help.weareindy.com), agencyhandy.com/pricing-plan/. Dubsado monthly ($35/$55) confirmed on /pricing-table; /pricing shows annual-only. Bonsai is per-seat; monthlyUsd = per-user rack rate. Agency Handy annual prices require the publicly advertised 'Yearly70' promo (70% off); monthly = undiscounted rack rate; annualDiscountPct=null because discount needs a coupon, not an automatic toggle. INDY CAVEAT: the live weareindy.com/pricing page now surfaces only a biennial display ($12.50/mo billed $300 every 2 years); the help-center article (last updated Oct 2024) still states $25/mo month-to-month and $225/yr annual. monthlyUsd retained as the corroborated month-to-month rate ($25) but the live page no longer publishes a separate annual figure, so annualDiscountPct softened to null and notes flag the conflict. Compliance set true only where vendor explicitly states it (Bonsai SOC 2 Type II 2025-07-03; GDPR via DPAs/privacy policies); else null. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: HoneyBook
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched and confirmed from honeybook.com/pricing on 2026-06-18 (Starter $29, Essentials $59/$49 annual, Premium $129/$109 annual). Integrations confirmed live on honeybook.com/product/integrations. HoneyBook markets 25% off annual for Essentials/Premium; annualDiscountPct reflects the true computed monthly savings from published prices (~17% / ~15%). Compliance not stated on public pages; null.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Unlimited clients and projects, invoices and payments, proposals and contracts, client portal, calendar, basic reports, up to 2 live lead forms, HoneyBook AI. Same $29/mo monthly or annual.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Everything in Starter plus scheduler, automations, QuickBooks, up to 2 team members, up to 10 live lead forms, SMS reminders, remove HoneyBook branding, standard reports. Annual billing: $49/mo ($588/yr); HoneyBook markets this as 25% off.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Everything in Essentials plus unlimited team members, priority support, multiple companies, advanced reports, unlimited live lead forms. Annual billing: $109/mo ($1,308/yr); HoneyBook markets this as 25% off.

limits: Starter: up to 2 live lead forms
Essentials: up to 2 team members, up to 10 live lead forms
Premium: unlimited team members, unlimited lead forms
keyFeatures: Proposals, contracts, invoices in one flow
enrichment.provenance: Plan features and prices confirmed from honeybook.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. 30-day free trial, no forever-free plan. Compliance certifications not stated on public pages; null.

plans.name: Basic

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per user/month. Everything in Basic plus invoices and payments, proposals and contracts, all templates, forms and questionnaires, scheduling, client portal, expense and income tracking. Annual: $19/user/mo.

plans.notes: Per user/month. Most popular. Everything in Essentials plus project insights, workload management, Gantt view, deals pipeline, custom fields, client tasks and messaging, profit reports, remove Bonsai branding, QuickBooks/Zapier/Calendly/Google integrations. Annual: $29/user/mo.

vendors.name: 17hats
vendors.provenance: Confirmed from 17hats.com/pricing 2026-06-18. Single all-inclusive plan with monthly/yearly/bi-yearly cycles plus a limited free CRM plan. Yearly $600/yr; promotional first-year $300 (50% off) advertised when bypassing trial. Bi-yearly $800/2yr.

plans.name: Free CRM
plans.notes: Forever free. Unlimited contacts and projects, but limited to 4 invoices per quarter. Includes email templates and sales tax reporting. No client portal, workflows, or scheduling.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.notes: All-inclusive plan billed month to month. Unlimited contacts, projects, invoices, quotes, contracts, questionnaires, client portal, workflows, scheduler, Zapier, payments via Stripe and Square. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Yearly
plans.notes: Same all-inclusive features as Monthly. Billed $600/year ($50/mo equivalent), ~17% savings vs monthly. Promotional first-year price of $300 (50% off) advertised at time of fetch. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Bi-Yearly
plans.notes: Same all-inclusive features. Billed $800 every two years (~$33/mo equivalent), ~45% savings vs monthly. Promotional first-year price of $400 (50% off) advertised at time of fetch. 7-day free trial.

limits: Free plan: 4 invoices per quarter only
Paid plans: unlimited documents, contacts, and projects
keyFeatures: Single all-inclusive plan — no feature gating between tiers

enrichment.provenance: Pricing and plan structure confirmed from 17hats.com/pricing 2026-06-18. Free CRM plan exists. No compliance certifications on public pages; null.
